node: Workforce credential content, licensure prep, and continuing education
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around regulated workforce credential content, licensure preparation, and continuing education. The best underfollowed angle is healthcare workforce compliance and CE, where education spend is tied to licensure renewal, employer onboarding, clinical competency, credentialing, and regulatory requirements rather than discretionary online learning. Reference anchors include scaled healthcare educators, but the discovery lane points to smaller or messier-label businesses where credential content is embedded inside healthcare software, postsecondary holdings, or conglomerate education segments.
